text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim and thesis","quality":"organization","description":"It states a position early and sets up the main reasons the essay will argue for that position."},{"evidence":"“First… Lastly… In conclusion”","quality":"structural coherence","description":"It uses paragraph transitions and a logical progression that make the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"accidents, public transportation, and safety details","quality":"support development","description":"It develops multiple reasons with article-based evidence instead of relying mostly on one general claim."},{"evidence":"“could help stop car accidents caused by drunk drivers or people not paying attention”","quality":"explanatory reasoning","description":"It explains how the evidence connects to the claim, rather than just listing facts from the article."},{"evidence":"closing reflection about relaxing on a long drive","quality":"conclusion effectiveness","description":"It ends with a memorable wrap-up that reinforces the position instead of stopping abruptly."}]}
